description: Search AliExpress for products using the shopper's own words in any language (Hebrew, Arabic, German, Spanish, Japanese, …) — no need to know the English product name. Returns real listings with price, rating, order count, store and a link. Prices are for delivery to the given country. Links are affiliate links (OneFindMe may earn a commission; the price is the same for the buyer).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the delivery country, e.g. US, GB, DE, IL, SA. Default US.

language.description: Language of the query and of the returned titles (ISO 639-1, e.g. en, he, ar, de). Default: detected from the query script, else en.

max_price.description: Maximum price in the country's currency.

max_results.description: How many products to return (1-20). Default 8.

min_price.description: Minimum price in the country's currency.

query.description: What the shopper is looking for, in any language, e.g. "מעיל חם לפעוט" or "wireless earbuds for running".

name: search_products
title: Search AliExpress products
